technical_and_design_decisions: Baseline stack: Java 17 with Spring Framework 6 / Spring Boot 3 in the existing multi-module Maven build; the increment targets the existing Spring XD-style runtime (streams/jobs, deployable modules, Tuple model, HDFS sink, JDBC source, pluggable MessageBus).

U1 and U2 parameterization is implemented as typed option classes (e.g., @ConfigurationProperties-based CodeGenOptions and MergeOptions) exposed via module option metadata, with placeholder/SpEL resolution at stream/job deployment time; options are passed through to the code generation and megastore-backed delta merge logic respectively.

U3 timeout is a job-level option (with default and units) enforced by a watchdog around the job's TaskExecutor (Future.get with timeout / scheduled interrupt); a hung execution is interrupted, cleaned up, and transitioned to FAILED status.

U4 is delivered as (a) a reusable SQL script processor module and (b) a job tasklet, both delegating script parsing and execution to Spring's ScriptUtils/JdbcTemplate with configurable statement separator, continue-on-error flag, and injected DataSource.

U5 adds a rowMapper option to the JDBC source accepting a user-provided RowMapper<Tuple> bean reference; the existing column-name-based mapper remains the default, and a sample enriching mapper (timestamp + delete flag) is provided as test/example code.
U6 implements SpEL evaluation in file/HDFS sink directory and file-name patterns, exposing variables such as timestamp and job/stream context values with date formatting support.
U7 adds configurable delimiter escaping (default backslash) to the delimited Tuple converter, applied on write and honored on read, verified for Hive/HAWQ-compatible CSV output.

U8 refactors MessageBus message transformation to a codec-based pipeline with byte[]/ByteBuffer passthrough when producer and consumer encodings match, eliminating redundant convert-serialize-deserialize cycles; JMH microbenchmarks guard throughput.

Testing stack: JUnit 5 + Mockito for unit tests; integration tests with embedded H2/Testcontainers for SQL/JDBC and MiniDFSCluster for HDFS; all new options documented in option metadata and reference docs.
assumptions: Effort is for a single experienced developer already familiar with the codebase; figures are work-hours (not elapsed time) and exclude external waits such as CI queue time and review latency.

No UI work is required; new options are exposed through the existing definition DSL/REST layer and option metadata only.
Peer code reviews are performed by others; only this developer's rework effort is included.

Documentation scope is limited to option metadata descriptions, reference doc updates, and short usage examples.
Test fixtures (H2, Testcontainers, MiniDFSCluster) and a performance environment for U8 benchmarks are available.
Estimates include per-feature unit and integration tests plus one consolidated end-to-end regression for the whole increment.
